about: The host's proof to the helper (helper/src/host-auth.ts, apps/caret CaretHostCore/HostAuth.swift); both sides' tests check these values. launchSecret is the launcher's 32 bytes (the ASCII of 'caret-b23-golden-launch-secret!!'); hostKey is HMAC-SHA256(launchSecret, 'caret-host-key'), the raw 32 bytes the hex names; proof is base64 HMAC-SHA256(hostKey, 'caret-host-proof\n' + nonce). lines are the handshake after a consumer hello with host: true: the helper's challenge, the host's proof, the helper's acceptance.
